question: 62yo, nocturia 4x, weak stream, intermittency, biopsy likelihood (repeat)

options.text: Perform ultrasound for residual urine assessment
Request blood sample for prostate-specific antigen
Unlikely this patient will need biopsy from prostate
His past history and medications have to be checked

correct_text: Unlikely this patient will need biopsy from prostate
purpose_ar: يريد التأكيد المتكرر أن أعراض تضخم البروستات الحميد النمطية وحدها لا تستدعي خزعة بروستاتية غالبًا.
